$description: Thalura design tokens — the single source for the layout values of generated planning and material documents (colours, fonts, spacing, table/column styling) that were migrated out of the content specification. Slides typography and the school-branding palette remain specified in template-specification.md and the branding pipeline for now. Populated with the CURRENT design; the deferred redesign re-populates the same schema. Nothing downstream may hard-code a value that exists here.

$conventions.rule_eighthpt: w:sz border units are eighths of a point: 4 = 0.5 pt
$conventions.tables_widths: column widths in twips (dxa); per table, cols sum to word.page.content_width (9072)
$conventions.pointer_resolution: semantic-tier pointers to colour primitives ({primitive.color.*}) resolve to {"value": ...} objects - consumers read .value; pointers to font/size/space/rule primitives resolve to bare scalars

header_fill.note: medium grey table header — survives photocopy

rule_min.note: minimum line/border grey that survives copying

brand_seed.note: neutral education-blue fallback; a school brand replaces this (branding pipeline, unchanged here)

font.note: current design uses Arial across Word documents; Verdana is the slide accessibility font

size_word_halfpt.note: current: Titel 14pt, Heading2 13pt, Heading3 11pt, Normal 11pt, Kopfzeile/Fußzeile 8pt, footnote 8pt

tables.$note: per-content-table column layout migrated out of document-specifications.md; generator skills read these via template-specification.md; each cols[] sums to 9072.
